note: Jackson County MN (FIPS 27063) publishes its zoning only as a PDF zoning map (co.jackson.mn.us) and a 1993 development code PDF; no ArcGIS REST or other queryable zoning districts service found. City of Jackson and City of Windom also publish zoning only as PDF maps (2017). The GIS data for the county is sold as shapefiles and the Beacon viewer is not a public service. The gis.mijackson.org and Jackson County WI hub results are other states' counties and were excluded.
